nodes.label: A-Level Economics A practice paper generator.
Paper configs
nodes.description: Paper 1/2/3 structures: sections, marks, command words, choice groups.

nodes.label: Blueprint validation
nodes.description: Rejects invalid themes, missing mark schemes, bad MCQ structure, and embedded mark text.

nodes.label: Economics Past Paper Generator
nodes.description: Unofficial Edexcel A Economics paper/source/mark-scheme generator.

nodes.label: generate_paper.py
nodes.description: Interactive runner: choose paper, Ollama, optional seed, writes Downloads.

nodes.label: generate_package pipeline
nodes.description: Loads syllabus, chooses random seed, builds blueprint, optionally calls Ollama, validates, renders PDFs, writes audit.

nodes.label: Random run seed
nodes.description: Unseeded runs use secrets.randbits(64); seed is shown in progress and saved in audit.

nodes.label: Syllabus seed JSON
nodes.description: Specification topic IDs, themes, titles, and allowed points.

nodes.label: PaperBlueprint
nodes.description: Structured paper with questions, parts, source material, mark schemes, and indicative content.

nodes.label: Blueprint generator
nodes.description: Chooses topics, applies section patterns, filters essay-capable topics, builds deterministic draft prompts/source cases.

nodes.label: Essay-capable topic guard
nodes.description: Section B/C and 15/25 markers avoid shallow topics like 1.1 Nature of economics and 1.2.1 rational decision making.

nodes.label: Uploaded notes system
nodes.description: Maps topic IDs to extracted note text and ranks note snippets/points by title and keywords.

nodes.label: Uploaded note PDFs
nodes.description: Original syllabus notes copied into data/notes/pdf.

nodes.label: Extracted note text
nodes.description: pdftotext outputs used by notes.py and Ollama prompts.

nodes.label: Ollama LLM enrichment
nodes.description: Builds constrained JSON prompts using syllabus + note context, sanitizes LLM drift, preserves exam command-word patterns.

nodes.label: PDF rendering
nodes.description: ReportLab rendering for question paper, source booklet, and mark scheme.

nodes.label: Question paper PDF
nodes.description: Exam-style question paper written to Downloads.

nodes.label: Source booklet PDF
nodes.description: Section B/Paper 3 source booklet written to Downloads.

nodes.label: Mark scheme PDF
nodes.description: Reference-style mark scheme with question focus, source evidence, note-derived points, and levels.

nodes.label: Audit JSON
nodes.description: Records paper metadata, seed, topic IDs, and section/topic allocation.

nodes.label: Test suite
nodes.description: Pytest coverage for structure, randomness, notes, prompts, rendering, mark schemes, validation, source booklet.
